metaTitulo: MUGU (Multas Guate) — Got a fine? We explain it to you
metaDescripcion: Check traffic fines in Guatemala: legality status, deadlines and what to do.
heroSubtitulo: Understand what it means, whether it's valid and what you can do
disclaimer: Educational tool, not legal advice. Consult a lawyer.
footer: Independent project — not affiliated with MINGOB
sugerirIdiomaDesc: Know a language we should support? Tell us which one.
menuBuscarDesc: Enter your plate and check if you have fines in your municipality
menuMultaDesc: You have the paper ticket: enter its details
menuInfoDesc: Types of fines explained in plain language
formFisicaSubtitulo: Fill in your ticket details to look it up
errorNoEncontrado: If your fine doesn't show up, wait 3 days from the day you received it
errorNoEncontradoNota: Check that the plate and entity are correct.
notifFotoDesc: Camera or sensor fine: nobody stopped you and there's no physical photo. You only find out when you check your plate here. The notification is TODAY, the day you first saw it on this portal.
notifFisicaDesc: Physical fine (paper): the notification date is the day the officer HANDED you the document. If they stopped you for something you just did, it's that same day. If they handed you a paper for an earlier fine (e.g. camera), it's the delivery date, not the violation date.
multasListSub: select one to see the details
multasListSin: No pending fines for this plate and entity.
notifLabel: When were you notified of this fine?
notifNota: Platforms (SAT, EMETRA, municipalities) don't provide the notification date. If you saw it here on the portal, the date is TODAY. If it's a physical fine, the date is the same as the issue date.
notifHoy: Today (I saw it on the portal)
tlPrescripcionDetalle: 120 days from issue: if it passes, the fine prescribes and you can request to have it removed.
estadoApelableDesc: You're within the 15 days from notification. You have the right to challenge the fine (appeal) or pay it. The appeal period expires on
estadoSoloPagoDesc: More than 15 days have passed since your notification. You can no longer appeal: you can only pay the fine.
estadoPrescritaDesc: More than 120 days have passed since issue without the process being completed. This fine has prescribed and you shouldn't pay it.
botonQuitarMulta: I want to remove the fine
quitarMultaDesc: Do you think the fine doesn't apply or has already prescribed? We can help you prepare the appeal to have it removed.
apelacionTexto: You can appeal at the corresponding traffic court within the legal deadlines. Bring your ticket, ID and supporting documents.
pagoTexto: You can pay at the counters of the entity that issued the fine or through authorized channels. Paying within the first 15 days may apply a discount.
tamanoDesc: Choose the font size for the whole app
errorNoEncontrado3dias: Fines take up to 3 days to appear. If your fine doesn't show up, wait 3 days from the day you received it.
errorNoMulta6: The fine number must have 6 digits
razonClaraDefault: This violation was recorded against the vehicle's plate according to current traffic regulations.
buscarAyudaPlaca: type the plate as it appears on the vehicle
pagoNotaDescuento: Remember: paying within the first 15 days from notification may apply a discount.
pagoBancoIndustrial: Banco Industrial (Mixco, Santa Catarina Pinula, Fraijanes)
pagoPortalSATDesc: Check and pay online from the SAT portal
pagoPresencialDesc: Counters of the entity that issued the fine
pagoEnLineaDesc: Virtual banking of the authorized bank
pagoNoOficial: This app doesn't process payments. We only guide you on where and how to pay.
pagoPaso1: Identify the entity that issued your fine (PNC, EMETRA, municipality)
pagoPaso2: Choose the payment channel: online, virtual banking or counter
pagoPaso3: Have your fine number and plate handy
pagoPaso5: Check on the portal that the fine shows as paid
pagoExitoDesc: This is an educational prototype: no real charge was made.
pagoPortalOficialDesc: You'll be redirected to the website of the entity that issued the fine
pagoSimulacionNota: Educational simulation — this app doesn't process real payments
recargoAnual: The amount increases 20% per year starting from the first year after notification.
terminosIntro: By using MUGU (Multas Guate) you accept these terms. If you don't agree, don't use the app.
terminosS1Texto: MUGU is an educational and informational tool. It is not legal advice and does not replace consulting a lawyer. Information about fines, deadlines and procedures is for guidance only.
terminosS2Texto: Fine, entity and deadline data comes from public sources (SAT, municipalities, Decree 33-2024) and may change. Always check official sources before making decisions.
terminosS3Texto: The payment gateway inside the app is an educational simulation. MUGU does not process real payments or store card data. To pay, use the entity's official channels.
terminosS4Texto: The app may link to official portals (SAT, municipalities). We are not responsible for the content or operation of external sites.
terminosS5Texto: MUGU is an independent community project. It does not represent or is not affiliated with MINGOB or any government entity.
terminosS6Texto: MUGU is provided "as is", without warranties. We are not responsible for decisions made based on the information shown.
terminosS7Texto: We may update these terms. Changes will be published on this page.
privacidadIntro: At MUGU we respect your privacy. This policy explains what data we handle and how.
privacidadS1Texto: To check your fines, you enter your plate. We also store on your device: language, text size, theme (light/dark) and recent plates.
privacidadS2Texto: Your preferences and recent plates are stored only on your device (browser localStorage). They are not sent to our servers.
privacidadS3Texto: When you search a plate, that plate is sent to a Google Sheets backend to check registered fines. We do not send your name, email or other personal data.
privacidadS4Texto: We do not sell, rent or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes.
privacidadS5Texto: The app is aimed at adults. We do not knowingly collect data from minors.
privacidadS6Texto: We may update this policy. Changes will be published on this page.
privacidadS7Texto: If you have privacy questions, write to us through the "Suggest a language" form or the project channels.
noNotificadoDesc: If you didn't receive the notification, the 120-day period runs from the issue date.
notifAyuda: The appeal (15 days) and prescription (120 days) deadlines are calculated from this date. If it's not correct, the deadlines change.
tlAyuda: The timeline shows the legal process of the fine: issue, notification, appeal, payment and prescription.
tlNota: Deadlines depend on the notification date being correct. If the date changes, deadlines are recalculated.
prescripcionAyuda: The fine prescribes at 120 days. If you were notified, the period runs from notification; if not, from issue.
situacionAyuda: Summary of your legal situation based on the issue and notification dates.
montoAyuda: The amount increases 20% per year starting from the first year after notification.
